Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misattributed the work by referring to “Mutarelli’s ‘Nina’,” implying Lourenço Mutarelli based or authored Nina, when in fact Nina is a 2004 film directed by Heitor Dhalia, for which Mutarelli created illustrations/animated sequences. This attribution error could misframe the task, even though the subsequent identification of Crime and Punishment (first published in 1866) remained correct.
